description: sdd-harness-web-ykryshtopa review gates: commit/merge/push guards, .claudeignore enforcement, typecheck-before-stop, session context banner

hooks.statusMessage: Checking staged diff for secrets, size, and protected-branch commits...
hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git-guard.sh" commit || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"sdd-harness: hooks/git-guard.sh did not run; confirm this git commit yourself."}}'

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git-guard.sh" merge || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"sdd-harness: hooks/git-guard.sh did not run; confirm this git merge yourself."}}'

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git-guard.sh" push || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"sdd-harness: hooks/git-guard.sh did not run; confirm this git push yourself."}}'

hooks.statusMessage: Checking for commits/refs written through the GitHub API...

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);ti=d.get("tool_input",{});print(ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("path") or "")'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){}const ti=j.tool_input||{};process.stdout.write(ti.file_path||ti.path||"")})'); else f=""; fi; if [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f .claudeignore ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; exit 0; fi; rel="$f"; case "$rel" in /*) rel="${rel#$PWD/}";; esac; while IFS= read -r pat; do pat=$(printf '%s' "$pat" | tr -d '\r'); case "$pat" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac; case "$rel" in $pat|$pat/*|*/$pat|*/$pat/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by .claudeignore pattern: %s"}}' "$pat"; exit 0;; esac; done < .claudeignore; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'

active=''; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then active=$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // empty'); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then active=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print("true" if d.get("stop_hook_active") else "")'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then active=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){}process.stdout.write(j.stop_hook_active?"true":"")})'); fi; if [ "$active" = true ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; [ -f tsconfig.json ] || exit 0; runCmd=''; tcScript=''; if [ -f .claude/harness.json ]; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(jq -r '[(.runCmd // ""), (.scripts.typecheck // "")] | @tsv' .claude/harness.json); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(python3 -c 'import json;d=json.load(open(".claude/harness.json"));print(str(d.get("runCmd") or "")+chr(9)+str((d.get("scripts") or {}).get("typecheck") or ""))'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".claude/harness.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write((d.runCmd||"")+"\t"+((d.scripts&&d.scripts.typecheck)||""))'); else out=""; fi; runCmd=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f1); tcScript=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f2); fi; if [ -n "$runCmd" ] && [ -n "$tcScript" ]; then cmd="$runCmd $tcScript"; elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then cmd='node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental'; else echo 'sdd-harness: no typecheck command — .claude/harness.json is missing (run init-harness) and node_modules/.bin/tsc is not installed. Skipping.' >&2; exit 0; fi; output=$($cmd 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$output" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

floor='2.1.220'; cc=$("${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-claude}" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1); if [ -n "$cc" ] && [ "$cc" != "$floor" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$cc" "$floor" | sort -V | head -1)" = "$cc" ]; then echo "=== Harness warning: Claude Code $cc is below the required $floor ==="; echo 'Gate 3 resolves no browser tools, the permissions block may not apply, and the Stop hook has no loop guard - all of them silently. Upgrade Claude Code, then re-run /init-harness.'; fi; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== Branch ==='; git branch --show-current; echo '=== Git Status ==='; git status -s; echo '=== Recent commits ==='; git log --oneline -5; else echo 'Not a git repository.'; fi; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; if [ -f PROGRESS.md ]; then echo '=== Progress (PROGRESS.md) ==='; awk '{gsub(/\r$/,"")} /^## Status$/{s=1;next} /^## Next steps$/{s=2;next} /^## /{s=0} s==1 && /^- (In progress|Blocked):/ {print} s==2 && NF {print}' PROGRESS.md; fi
